decisions.reason: Launched only in 2023, the single-tube air fin cooler still has unresolved prospects. It sits close to the firm's core heat exchanger know-how, so keeping the option open costs little.
This condenser is barely a year on the market with no negative evidence so far. Keeping the option alive is cheap, although it partly overlaps with Product C.
It largely duplicates Product B, which makes it a candidate for later consolidation. Uncertainty is still unresolved, so abandoning it now would be premature.
The tube liner repair product serves recurring maintenance demand at low carrying cost. That makes it a cheap option worth holding while its value becomes clear.
Customized air coolers are produced to order and carry minimal standing cost. They fit the firm's engineering-to-order business, so the option is kept.
The tube end repair inserts complement the liner product in the aftermarket and are inexpensive to keep listed. Results are still too early to justify abandoning them.
